Senior PM — Clinic Scheduling, EMEA remote.

Careslot (200 people, Series B) builds scheduling and rota software for private clinics across Europe. We're hiring a Senior PM to own appointment booking, clinician rota management and integrations with practice-management systems. No direct reports; you'll partner with a clinical-operations lead. Fully remote within Europe. Experience with healthcare workflows, HL7/FHIR integrations and clinical-safety standards is strongly preferred.
